classes.name: AbstractShardedPersistenceActor
classes.description: Abstract class implementing a sharded persistent actor with snapshotting, event handling, and recovery in Akka.

classes.name: CheckForActivity
classes.description: Inner class representing a message to trigger activity check based on access counter.

classes.name: Control
classes.description: Enum for control commands like taking snapshots.

methods.name: recoveryCompleted
methods.description: Callback after recovery completes; can be overridden for additional actions.

methods.name: becomeCreatedOrDeletedHandler
methods.description: Switches actor behavior based on entity state.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Initial message handler, defaults to deleted behavior.

methods.name: createReceiveRecover
methods.description: Defines recovery message handling, including snapshots and timeouts.

methods.name: becomeCreatedHandler
methods.description: Sets behavior for active entity, schedules activity checks and snapshots.

methods.name: becomeDeletedHandler
methods.description: Sets behavior for deleted entity, schedules activity checks and cancels snapshots.

methods.name: persistAndApplyEvent
methods.description: Persists an event, updates state, and applies event logic.

methods.name: checkForActivity
methods.description: Checks if actor should shutdown due to inactivity or deletion.

methods.name: passivate
methods.description: Requests parent to gracefully shutdown actor.

methods.name: takeSnapshot
methods.description: Creates a snapshot if conditions are met.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Applies an event to actor state and publishes it.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Logs shutdown message and passivates actor.
